integrity.provenance: Standalone derivation and executable finite rational verification; no independent scientific audit.
integrity.scientific_claim_boundary: A first-order uniform asymptotic for dense adsorption hosts whose forbidden complement has degree at most two.

scientific_limitations: The uniform asymptotic requires equal-probability edge order and missing-graph maximum degree two; it does not assert an explicit small-size threshold or second-order correction.
The complete primary texts of Dyer–Frieze (1991) and Pippenger (1989) could not be inspected; possible bibliographic overlap remains.
Finite checks verify particular instances only. Infinite correctness rests on the tagged-edge survival and multi-vertex comparison argument.
title: Universal first-order dimer jamming under degree-two forbidden-edge deletion
